title: NEET UG 2023 — Official Question Paper
description: Complete National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (UG) 2023 (Booklet G6). 200 questions across Physics, Chemistry, Botany, and Zoology with Section A & B optional choices.

instructions.en: The question paper comprises 200 multiple choice questions divided equally into 4 subjects: Physics, Chemistry, Botany, and Zoology. Each subject has Section A (35 compulsory questions, +4/-1) and Section B (15 questions, attempt any 10, +4/-1). Total time: 200 minutes. Maximum marks: 720.
